entities.summary: Ottoman Empire, a political institution in Sweden during Vasa Dynasty & Great Power Era (1697–1718). Grew from Gustavus Adolphus & the Thirty Years' War and Peace of Westphalia. Led to the emergence of Charles XII & the Great Northern War.
